description: estimated_risk_index_for_multiple_hazards is a hazard data set listed in ICPAC Geoportal (IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Centre), a regional geoportal (GeoNode), published or maintained by ICPAC. This dataset includes an estimate of the regional risk induced by multiple hazards (tropical cyclone, flood and landslide induced by precipitations). Unit is estimated risk index from 1 (low) to 5 (extreme). Coverage: Africa (the listing does not name one country). The portal files it under the publisher ICPAC. The portal shows 2019-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-icpac-portal.
